certification: DECLARED, NOT CERTIFIED. This file records the boundary as built and independently observable; it is not a self-certification of repair. An independent reviewer attacks the commit before adoption.

policy.dependency_graph: code dependencies must be acyclic and point at an equally or more stable provider; Image_Tagger -> cpp is a one-way dependency on a published protocol library, not a cycle
policy.foreign_access: foreign repository internals may be reached only through a declared interface resolved at one place
policy.absolute_paths: absolute paths naming a foreign repository, a host user, or a container sandbox are forbidden in active Python sources
policy.single_resolution_point: every runtime module obtains the provider through annotation_socket/_cpp_bootstrap.py; no module performs its own sys.path surgery
policy.fail_closed: an unsatisfied provider contract raises one diagnostic naming the contract and the remedies; it never degrades to a local lookalike
policy.self_certification: declared or provisional interfaces do not satisfy release readiness

provider_observation.enforcement_note: these commits are an OBSERVATION of the provider checkout at declaration time, not a pin. Nothing in this repository verifies them at run time, and the resolver will happily adopt a different provider revision. Treat as provenance, never as a guarantee.

interfaces.status_meaning: resolved from the same local provider checkout; a SEPARATE contract from cnfa_cpp.stage.v1
interfaces.why_separate: cpp/ is not self-contained at run time. cpp/worker_shim.py reuses the supervisor's classification and progress-watchdog primitives, and this repository takes its UNKNOWN trust sentinel from supervisor/trusted_derivation.py. A cnfa-cpp wheel that shipped only cpp/ would satisfy cnfa_cpp.stage.v1 and leave this contract unsatisfied, so the two are resolved, reported, and diagnosed independently.
